add_definitions(-D_WINE)
spec2def(msvfw32.dll msvfw32.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# msvfw32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/msvfw32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(msvfw32_shims OBJECT mciwnd.c msvideo_main.c drawdib.c)
target_link_libraries(msvfw32_shims PRIVATE wine oldnames libwinmm libcomctl32 libuser32 libgdi32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(msvfw32_shims)
add_cargo_module(msvfw32 msvfw32-cargo msvfw32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS msvfw32_shims psdk)
